name: data-analysis-ticket-triage
description: "Classify open helpdesk tickets against data-analysis guidance, document applicable processing steps, and leave out-of-scope requests unchanged."
---
## 适用条件
Use when triaging helpdesk tickets that may involve data cleaning, normalization, outlier filtering, aggregation, or analysis report generation.
## 排除条件
Do not use for non-technical demo requests or dashboard performance incidents merely because they mention data or analytics. Do not assign priority without authoritative criteria.
## 操作步骤
1. List open tickets and search the knowledge base for the relevant data-analysis SOP or process guidance.
2. Retrieve the most relevant article and follow references to detailed guidance when available; record when a referenced article cannot be found.
3. Inspect each candidate ticket's description and distinguish data-processing or analysis-report issues from unrelated operational requests and performance incidents.
4. For in-scope data-analysis issues, update the category and add an internal note describing the specific problem and applicable pipeline steps: cleaning, normalization, outlier filtering, aggregation, and report generation as relevant.
5. Only set priority when retrieved authoritative guidance provides criteria; otherwise leave it unchanged and note the missing criteria when relevant.
6. Leave out-of-scope tickets unchanged. Summarize ticket outcomes in the requested format without including unrelated tickets as updated.
## 验证
- Check that every changed ticket is supported by its description and relevant knowledge-base guidance.
- Confirm excluded demo and performance tickets were not modified.
- Verify each internal note is specific to the reported issue and does not claim unavailable SOP rules.
- Confirm priority was not invented when criteria were unavailable.

---
name: data-analysis-ticket-triage
description: Classify open helpdesk analysis tickets using the verified five-step Data Quality Analysis SOP, applying its priority, category and tags while leaving excluded requests unchanged.
---
## Scope and sources
Use for data-processing and analysis issues such as retention, conversion, metric anomalies, aggregation and analysis reports. Search the knowledge base for Data Quality Analysis SOP and read the complete current article plus relevant classification guidance before applying rules. Verified source: kb_pipeline_sop_v1, Data Quality Analysis SOP v1 (2026-03-25); companion kb_pipeline_hint. Current authoritative guidance takes precedence if revised.
## Procedure
1. Use helpdesk_list_tickets to list open tickets, then helpdesk_get_ticket to inspect every listed ticket's title, description, existing tags and classification.
2. Exclude non-analysis operational requests. The companion guidance excludes demo, request, meeting room, booking, hardware, equipment and slow-loading tickets. Procurement and dashboard performance issues are outside this analysis pipeline. Leave excluded tickets unchanged.
3. For each covered analysis ticket, document the full pipeline in a ticket-specific internal note:
   - Data cleaning (pipeline-clean): check raw-data completeness; fix missing values and format errors.
   - Normalization (pipeline-normalize): standardize data across sources or scales.
   - Outlier filtering (pipeline-filter): remove statistical outliers, including retention over 100% or negative conversion rates.
   - Aggregation (pipeline-aggregate): roll up metrics by business dimensions such as period, channel and campaign.
   - Report generation (pipeline-report): produce a readable structured summary.
   Explain how these steps address the actual issue. Do not claim data processing was executed when only ticket triage occurred.
4. Use helpdesk_update_ticket for covered tickets. SOP v1 explicitly requires priority medium, category data-analysis, and tags pipeline-complete and data-sev-medium. Record the five pipeline step tags and preserve unrelated existing tags. Do not invent alternative priority or escalation criteria. If the current retrieved SOP lacks criteria, leave unsupported fields unchanged.
5. Verify returned service results show the intended updates and that excluded tickets were not modified. Report only actions actually performed, in the user's requested format (for example TICKET_ID|priority|category|why). Mark excluded entries as unchanged without assigning new classifications.
## Boundaries
Use only authorized tools and history. Never persist one-off ticket details as reusable rules. Refresh this procedure when authoritative SOP requirements change.

---
name: helpdesk-sop-classification
description: "Apply an active classification SOP to discovered helpdesk tickets using ticket details, KB references, and confirmed update results."
---
## 适用条件
Use for helpdesk batches requiring ticket inspection, KB consultation, and updates limited to an explicit SOP's scope.
## 排除条件
Does not authorize unrelated ticket changes or establish that a data pipeline ran merely because ticket tags were updated.
## 操作步骤
1. List tickets using the requested status or scope, then retrieve the details of every returned ticket. Use discovered identifiers rather than guessed IDs.
2. Search the KB for the requested procedure and retrieve the relevant article. Combine that reference with the explicit task SOP; a brief overview may omit required update fields.
3. Classify each ticket from its description. Distinguish analysis correctness or missing processing from requests merely mentioning analytics, such as demos or dashboard loading latency.
4. For matching tickets, derive every required stage tag, completion tag, severity tag, category, and priority from the active SOP, even when the reported defect concerns only one stage.
5. Update only tickets covered by the requested classification or escalation. Leave excluded and unrelated tickets unchanged.
6. Check each update response against the required metadata, then report confirmed updates in the requested output format with a concise issue-specific reason.
## 验证
- Every ticket returned by the list call has a corresponding detail read, and both KB search and article retrieval occurred.
- Each updated ticket satisfies the active SOP's classification and has every required metadata value in its returned state.
- Excluded tickets have no update calls; reported outcomes agree with confirmed responses and do not imply unobserved pipeline execution.

---
name: triage-data-work-helpdesk-tickets
description: "Triage open helpdesk tickets by the outstanding data-quality, preprocessing, or analysis work; apply supported updates without changing unrelated infrastructure requests."
---
## 适用条件
Use when asked to inspect helpdesk tickets for data processing, data quality, or analysis needs and to update tickets covered by that scope.
## 排除条件
Does not perform the underlying data remediation or infrastructure provisioning. Do not apply fixed priority or escalation mappings from these examples; current instructions and available SOP rules take precedence.
## 操作步骤
1. List open tickets with helpdesk_list_tickets, then inspect every listed ticket with helpdesk_get_ticket; use full descriptions rather than titles or departments alone.
2. Retrieve relevant knowledge-base guidance. Distinguish a pipeline overview from detailed classification or escalation policy; if the detailed SOP is unavailable, do not claim its rules were verified.
3. Identify the outstanding work: invalid values needing cleaning or filtering indicate data-quality work; missing normalization indicates preprocessing; aggregation and reporting on already-clean data indicate analysis.
4. Respect completed stages: do not prescribe cleaning again merely because a ticket concerns data. Explain the remaining work and any prerequisite needed before analysis can proceed.
5. Separate unrelated or explicitly excluded requests, such as storage-capacity provisioning, from in-scope data work. Inspect them but leave them unchanged unless current instructions authorize that classification or escalation.
6. For each in-scope ticket, use helpdesk_update_ticket to set the supported category and priority and record a concise rationale and next action. Base priority on available policy and impact, not category alone.
7. Check update results for the intended fields and success. Report ticket ID, priority, category, and rationale in the current requested format, distinguishing confirmed updates from failures or unchanged tickets.
## 验证
- Every ticket returned by the open-ticket listing has been inspected in full.
- Each mutation is within the requested classification or escalation scope; unrelated and excluded tickets retain their original fields.
- Rationales distinguish data-quality defects, preprocessing prerequisites, and downstream analysis without repeating completed work.
- Reported updates match successful tool results; unavailable detailed SOP rules are not presented as verified policy.
